analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem reported quarterly revenue from operations of ₹532 crore for Q1 FY27, representing a 35% year-on-year growth despite raw material supply constraints and geopolitical disruptions. Quarterly EBITDA increased 36% year-on-year to ₹89 crore, while profit after tax grew 54% to ₹47 crore. Management stated that capacity utilization was impacted by raw material availability during the quarter, but expects performance to improve as supply issues resolve. The company expects to achieve an additional 30%-35% turnover growth over the previous year, targeting over ₹500 crore in quarterly turnover for the remaining quarters of FY27. Krishana Phoschem reported strong operational and financial performance for the period ending June 2026, driven by expanded capacities and favorable sector dynamics.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over the previous year as newly expanded capacity ramps up.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of approximately 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

demand_outlook.claim: A strong revival in July monsoon activity reduced the national rainfall deficit from nearly 40% in June to approximately 24% by early July.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July.

demand_outlook.claim: The Government of India increased Minimum Support Prices for all 14 mandatory Kharif crops for the 2026-27 marketing season.
demand_outlook.quote: The Government of India announced higher MSPs of all 14 mandatory Kharif crops for the 2026-27 marketing season, featuring meaningful increases for key commercial and food crops like soybean, groundnut, cotton, and pulses.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive due to comfortable domestic stock levels and a favorable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects domestic fertilizer demand to remain stable as water levels in major reservoirs and rivers are higher compared to earlier periods.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking its total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved by the Board.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK and DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached ₹89 crore, delivering a 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stand at approximately 7%–8% for trading operations and around 16% for manufacturing operations.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%–30% of input cost increases through higher subsidy support and revisions in MRPs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs contributed to higher Q1 FY27 EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q4 FY26 stood at Rs. 756 crore, up 60% YoY.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs.756 crore, up 60% YoY, primarily driven by higher sales volumes supported by strong Rabi demand, along with better realizations across product segments.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 came in at Rs. 90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming trends in input prices driven by supply-side constraints and higher logistic costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, capacity utilization stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production achieved during Q1 FY27 was 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: At 100% capacity utilization across current asset bases, total potential revenue can exceed ₹3,000 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Based on the capacity and the pricing I have mentioned, the total revenue potential can be more than ₹3,000 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for Q4 FY26 reached 94,103 MT driven by peak Rabi demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for the year FY26 was 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes for the year were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of its equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables stand at almost Rs. 400 crore and other receivables range between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Subsidy because we, that import materials we supplied substantially within this last quarter. So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainty surrounding shipping routes through West Asia led to higher freight costs, vessel delays, and elevated procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input costs created a timing mismatch where domestic demand slowed down in March while input costs were increasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover run-rate of more than ₹500 crore during the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The 70,000 MTPA green ammonia agreement capacity under arrangement with SECI will commence operations in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over last year across the remaining quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the newly expanded capacity to stabilize over the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the green ammonia supply to be available after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects top-line and performance growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
